# @arki/dot

> The app kernel for `@arki`: typed plugins, a 5-hook lifecycle (`configure`, `boot`, `start`, `stop`, `dispose`), features as a chain, and a JSON CLI (`dot new`, `dot explain`, `dot doctor`, `dot dev`). It is not a web server, an ORM or a DI container; adapters live in other packages.

Wrong wiring is a compile error at `.use()`. Read `.data` from the CLI's JSON: it IS the manifest (`explain`) or the diagnostics snapshot (`doctor`).

## Import paths
<!-- llms:start -->
- `@arki/dot`: Compose an app from typed plugins that boot in declaration order and dispose in reverse. `DOT_LIFECYCLE_HOOKS`, `DOT_MANIFEST_ERROR_CODE`, `DotLifecycleError`, `DotLifecycleErrorCode`, `DotManifestError`, `DotPluginError`, `bootTestApp`, `defineApp`, `fake`, `hookSignals`, `initPlugins`, `isLazy`; and 82 more.
- `@arki/dot/plugin`: The plugin author's surface: `plugin`, handles, tokens, `rename` and the contract types. `DOT_LIFECYCLE_HOOKS`, `DotLifecycleError`, `DotLifecycleErrorCode`, `DotPluginError`, `bootTestApp`, `defineApp`, `handleOf`, `initPlugins`, `isLazy`, `lazy`, `lazyOf`, `plugin`; and 73 more.
- `@arki/dot/feature`: Domain modules for Dot apps: `defineFeature`, its routers and the services bag. `FEATURE_ERROR_CODES`, `FeatureError`, `allFeatures`, `bindDriver`, `composeRepos`, `composeRouter`, `defineFeature`, `driven`, `driver`, `entrypointOnly`, `entrypointsOf`, `feature`; and 87 more.
- `@arki/dot/orpc`: oRPC procedures for `defineFeature` features, contract first. `RPC_ACTION_META_SCHEMA`, `errorCaptureMiddleware`, `needsMiddleware`, `rpc`; types `BoundContext`, `BuiltRouter`, `ContractKeysGuard`, `ErrorCaptureInfo`, `ProcedureFactories`, `RequestContextShape`.
- `@arki/dot/cli`: The `dot` command line, built on `@arki/cli`: `program`, the run functions and the `dot.*` failures. `AppImportFailed`, `AppInvalidExport`, `AppLifecycleFailed`, `AppNotFound`, `DEV_STATE_PATH`, `DevAlreadyRunning`, `DevAppStarted`, `DevDbUnreachable`, `DevPortInUse`, `DevPreflightFailed`, `DevRemoteDbRefused`, `DevRunnerFailed`; and 30 more.
- `@arki/dot/log`: `log()`: the plugin that fills Dot's logging slot with an `@arki/log` configuration. `DOT_LOG_ERROR_CODES`, `log`; types `LogServices`.
- `@arki/dot/runtime`: `createAppRuntime`: the one started Dot app of a server process, safe under Vite hot updates. `createAppRuntime`.
- `@arki/dot/test-harness`: Test builders that boot plugins against fakes: `testPlugin`, `testApp` and `bootTestApp`. `bootTestApp`, `fake`, `testApp`, `testPlugin`; types `TestAppOptions`, `TestAppServices`, `TestPluginBuilder`.
<!-- llms:end -->

## Rules that bite
- `.data` is the payload. There is no `.data.manifest` and no `.data.diagnostics`.
- `dot explain` only configures. `dot doctor` boots and disposes; it never calls `start()`.
- `configure` is sync and does no I/O. `boot` returns nothing; values go in `provides`.
- Providers come before consumers. The wrong order is a compile error, or `ARKI_DOT_E020`.
- A second instance of a plugin needs `rename`, or its keys collide (`ARKI_DOT_E013`).
- Do not cast an app to read its manifest. Call `.configure().manifest`.
- `@arki/dot` never imports its adapters (`@arki/env/dot`, `@arki/db/dot`, `@arki/kv/dot`, `@arki/journal/dot`).
